{"reason": "Changed the medium/high branch action from suggest-alternative-supplier to alert-planner: 35000 vs 45000 and always arrives in time, so it dominates. It fixes all 4 stockout rows (e.g. medium 2.8/5.3 costed 195000) and cuts the 34 supplier-switches. Projected: stockouts 4→0, cost 2165000→~1225000, fitness −2.565→−1.225.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
